item.title: Kyler Murray will return at QB for the Vikings this week after clearing the concussion protocol
item.description: Minnesota Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray has been cleared from the NFL concussion protocol and will return to action this week at Tampa Bay

item.title: News outlets sue Trump over lost White House access, citing 'blatant violation' of First Amendment
item.description: CNN, MS NOW and Politico have filed a lawsuit over being denied White House access

item.title: AP Exclusive: ICE hides locations of thousands of detainees with final removal orders
item.description: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement has stopped publicly revealing where it is holding most detainees who are subject to final deportation orders, in a move that has made it harder for lawyers and relatives to find them

item.title: New York airport operations resume after disruptions across US Northeast due to technical problems
item.description: Flights are taking off and landing at New York City-area airports with some delays and cancellations after technicians repaired data lines that failed at a key regional air traffic control center in Philadelphia

item.title: Jury convicts Vermont man of attempted murder in shooting of 3 Palestinian students
item.description: A jury has convicted a Vermont man of attempted murder in the shootings of three Palestinian college students who were walking near his home, rejecting an insanity defense rooted in his claims that he was acting on orders from the CIA and Mossad

item.title: Firefighting helicopter crashes near Yosemite, killing both pilots
item.description: Officials say two helicopter pilots have been killed in a crash while battling a wildfire at Yosemite National Park in California

item.title: Andy Burnham seeks common ground with Trump at the UN and pitches the UK as a major AI player
item.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham is facing a big test on the world stage

item.title: Up to 30 shots fired after man opened fire on officer outside Ontario synagogue
item.description: A 29-year-old man opened fire on a police officer outside an Ontario synagogue during Yom Kippur, leading to a shootout with up to 30 shots fired

item.title: Amateur archaeologist finds Germany’s biggest hoard of ancient Roman silver coins
item.description: An amateur archaeologist has discovered a significant hoard of Roman silver coins in western Germany

item.title: China's Alibaba unveils new powerful chip and ambitious AI model plans
item.description: China's Alibaba has unveiled new plans for its AI model and new chip technologies, including what it claims is China's most powerful AI chip

item.title: China expands export control on drug precursors ahead of Trump-Xi meeting
item.description: China is now requiring permits for exports to the U.S., Mexico, and Canada of two additional chemicals used to make illegal drugs

item.title: Judge won't block Trump administration from giving SpaceX acres of wildlife refuge in land swap
item.description: A federal judge has refused to block the Trump administration from giving SpaceX more than 700 acres of wildlife refuge as part of a land swap in Texas

item.title: Bill Gates pushes for 'smart use' of AI as his foundation builds more representative language data
item.description: The Gates Foundation is convening Anthropic, Google, OpenAI Foundation and dozens of other organizations to help make artificial intelligence more accessible in underrepresented languages

item.title: California farmers are struggling to sell grapes as demand for wine drops
item.description: It’s harvest time in California wine country, but many growers are struggling to sell their grapes as Americans cut back on drinking

item.title: Shooter opens fire near a high school in Turkey, wounding at least 11
item.description: An attacker opened fire near a high school in western Turkey, wounding at least 11 people
